title: 2D Yang-Mills Heat Kernel Techniques for 3D/4D Extension
description: Surveys the obstacles and partial results for extending 2D Yang-Mills heat kernel techniques to 3D (Chern-Simons) and 4D (Millennium Prize). In 2D, the theory is exactly solvable via the heat kernel on the gauge group. In higher dimensions, the theory has physical degrees of freedom that prevent exact computation.
